Product centered, filling about 70% of the frame, perfectly sharp, true-to-life colors. No props, no text.

title: Glacier Ice
description: Clear ice blocks and frosted blue light — crisp, cold, refreshing.
shots: [{"name":"Hero","prompt":"The main composition exactly as described."},{"name":"Variation 1","prompt":"Hovering a few centimeters above a single ice cube with a soft shadow below."},{"name":"Variation 2","prompt":"Half-embedded in crushed ice, top-down 45 degrees."}]
source: Higgsfield Marketing Studio presets “Ice Cube Hover”, “Chilled Can” · Pinterest Predicts 2026 “Cool Blue” (frosted makeup +150%)
prompt: The product stands upright on a cluster of crystal-clear sculpted ice blocks. Small ice shards and fine frost crystals lie around the base, with a thin cold mist low in the frame. Smooth background gradient from glacier blue to pale icy white. A cool backlight shines through the ice for luminous caustics and refractions, with soft frontal fill keeping the product's true colors accurate. 100mm macro lens, f/5.6, eye level, product tack-sharp, ice softly defocused. Fresh, cold, clean, premium mood. No text.

title: Sunlit Linen
description: Warm window light and leaf shadows on soft linen — calm Korean lifestyle mood.

title: First Snow
description: Snowy windowsill and falling snowflakes — quiet, pure first-snow mood.
shots: [{"name":"Hero","prompt":"The main composition exactly as described."},{"name":"Variation 1","prompt":"Outdoors, the product half-nestled in a small mound of fresh powder snow, snowflakes falling, top-down 45 degrees."},{"name":"Variation 2","prompt":"Close crop with delicate frost patterns on the glass softly framing the product."}]
prompt: The product rests on a white-painted wooden windowsill dusted with fresh snow crystals. Behind it a softly frosted windowpane, snowflakes drifting down over a blurred pale winter street. Cool overcast daylight from the window balanced by a faint warm glow from inside the room, gentle soft shadows. A small sprig of pine and a few loose snowflakes nearby, out of focus. Palette of snow white, silver grey and soft blue with one warm accent. 85mm lens, f/2.8, eye level, product tack-sharp with true-to-life colors. Quiet, pure, first-snow-day mood. No text.
